obligations.requirement: The DirectReferenceSource emits a deterministic backend-neutral structural plan for every G2 V1 RuntimeScene ObjectKind without using stale generic Stroke/Text kinds; Group remains an ordered traversal entry with explicit zero-pixel contribution.
obligations.oracle: Build a hand-authored nine-record RuntimeScene fixture with distinguishable content, transforms, properties, bounds, erase masks, dependencies, and final visibility order; compare every output field against independently authored expected ReferenceDrawList values.
obligations.acceptance: All nine kinds appear exactly once in the expected final order, every non-Group record maps to its exact typed renderer-neutral command, Group has deterministic order and zero pixel contribution, and no expected value is derived from the source under test.
obligations.evidence_required: Focused G3DirectReference structural test transcript plus fixture inventory JSON.

obligations.requirement: The plan is bound to the exact FrameState and VisibilityResult identities and preserves final visibility order, viewport clip, and camera mapping without re-querying visibility.
obligations.oracle: Use nontrivial camera center/zoom/rotation, logical surface metrics, viewport and erase clips, scene generation, read token, view/frame/surface/metrics generations, and a final order distinct from record storage order; independently calculate the expected renderer-neutral world-to-view affine mapping.
obligations.acceptance: ReferenceDrawList metadata exactly matches the hand-authored FrameState/VisibilityResult values, its world-to-view mapping equals the independent expected affine mapping, command order exactly equals VisibilityResult.backToFront, and mismatched scene/read identities or a missing visible RuntimeScene record fail deterministically rather than silently skipping or mixing generations.
obligations.evidence_required: Focused positive and negative G3DirectReference assertions.

obligations.requirement: The permanent reference plan has a stable versioned canonical byte representation and digest; digest is corroborative and never replaces exact structural comparison.
obligations.oracle: Build the same distinguishable plan twice and compare exact structures, canonical bytes, and digest; independently mutate representative identity, ordering, transform, property, content, dependency, erase-mask, camera, and clip fields and require the canonical bytes/digest to change.
obligations.acceptance: Identical inputs yield byte-identical canonical bytes and digest, every representative semantic change is detected, encoding version is explicit, and exact structure remains the primary equality oracle.
obligations.evidence_required: Committed reference-plan digest and replay/mutation test transcript.

obligations.requirement: With 100000 RuntimeScene records and approximately 500 visible IDs, DirectReferenceSource work is driven only by the visible set and performs no full RuntimeScene or SemanticDocument traversal.
obligations.oracle: Construct a 100000-record RuntimeScene fixture and a 500-ID VisibilityResult; inspect production diagnostics and dependencies while generating the plan.
obligations.acceptance: Exactly 500 visibility IDs are processed, exactly 500 RuntimeScene read-contract lookups are attempted, no RuntimeScene.records() iteration or semantic object iteration occurs in the normal source path, and output traversal entries correspond exactly to the 500 ordered visible IDs.
obligations.evidence_required: Traversal counters JSON plus focused locality test and production boundary scan.

obligations.requirement: G3-03 introduces no Skia/backend/platform contract, SemanticDocument/ObjectStore access, Tile/cache/scheduler optimization, prediction/ink/Arc behavior, or G3-04+ implementation and preserves G3-01/G3-02/G2 behavior.
obligations.oracle: Review-owned dependency scan over exact changed production/test files plus focused G3 predecessor tests and the full RF01/G2 regression matrix.
obligations.acceptance: Forbidden dependency scan is empty, mutation scope is exact, G3FrameState and G3Visibility pass, full RF01/G2 tests pass, and git diff --check passes.
obligations.evidence_required: Boundary scan, changed-path inventory, predecessor regression logs, and diff check.
